description: Independently established ground truth for the 5-target A/B/C security benchmark.

vulnerabilities.title: BOLA / IDOR in Document Export
vulnerabilities.description: export_document validates that current_user belongs to workspace_id, but the SQL query retrieves the document by id alone (WHERE id = ?) without scoping by workspace_id.
vulnerabilities.trigger: User in workspace A requests /api/workspaces/A/docs/{doc_B_id} and receives document belonging to workspace B.

vulnerabilities.title: Mass Assignment Privilege Escalation in Profile Update
vulnerabilities.description: update_user_profile binds arbitrary keys from user payload directly into dynamic UPDATE statement, allowing a non-admin user to set role='admin'.
vulnerabilities.trigger: Attacker submits payload {'role': 'admin'} to escalate privileges.

negative_controls.title: Secure Tenant Scoped Query
negative_controls.rationale: list_workspace_items strictly enforces tenant boundary by comparing current_user['workspace_id'] to route parameter and scoping SQL query with WHERE workspace_id = ?.

negative_controls.title: CSPRNG Invitation Token with Hash Storage and Expiry
negative_controls.rationale: create_invitation_token uses secrets.token_urlsafe(32) with SHA-256 storage hashing and 24h expiration timestamp.

vulnerabilities.title: SQL Injection in Product Search Route
vulnerabilities.description: searchProducts dynamically constructs SQL query by concatenating unsanitized req.query.q string into LIKE clause.
vulnerabilities.trigger: Attacker supplies ' OR 1=1 -- to leak unindexed or unauthorized records.

vulnerabilities.title: Unbounded GraphQL Circular Query Complexity DoS
vulnerabilities.description: Circular recursive relationship between Product and Review without query depth limiting or query complexity analysis enables resource exhaustion attacks.
vulnerabilities.trigger: Attacker submits deeply nested recursive GraphQL query product { reviews { product { reviews ... } } } causing catastrophic server resource exhaustion.

negative_controls.title: Parameterized SQL Query in Order Lookup
negative_controls.rationale: getOrder uses parameterized query placeholders ($1, $2) and strictly filters by both order ID and authenticated user ID.

negative_controls.title: Strict JWT Algorithm Pinning (RS256)
negative_controls.rationale: authenticate middleware specifies algorithms: ['RS256'], preventing algorithm confusion attacks (e.g. none or HMAC using public key).

vulnerabilities.title: Webhook Signature Verification Lacks Timestamp Replay Window
vulnerabilities.description: process_payment_webhook verifies payload HMAC signature but fails to validate timestamp_header freshness against a tolerance window (e.g. 5 minutes).
vulnerabilities.trigger: Attacker replays previously captured legitimate webhook payload and headers repeatedly.

vulnerabilities.title: Race Condition on Non-Atomic Wallet Balance Mutation
vulnerabilities.description: credit_wallet_balance reads balance into local variable, simulates an I/O delay, and writes back sum without atomic SQL increment (UPDATE ... SET balance = balance + ?) or row lock.
vulnerabilities.trigger: Concurrent webhook events or worker jobs read identical balance and overwrite each other, causing financial discrepancy.

negative_controls.title: Database Unique Constraint Idempotency Control
negative_controls.rationale: record_processed_event enforces atomic deduplication via ON CONFLICT (event_id) DO NOTHING.

negative_controls.title: Constant-Time Signature Comparison
negative_controls.rationale: verify_hmac_signature uses hmac.compare_digest to prevent side-channel timing attacks.

vulnerabilities.title: Indirect Prompt Injection via Unencapsulated Document Chunks
vulnerabilities.description: build_rag_prompt concatenates raw retrieved document chunks directly into system prompt without structural delimiters (e.g. XML tags) or boundary framing.
vulnerabilities.trigger: An untrusted external document indexed into the vector database contains instructions overriding system instructions.

vulnerabilities.title: Server-Side Request Forgery (SSRF) in External Reference Fetcher
vulnerabilities.description: fetch_document_from_url makes arbitrary HTTP requests using urllib.request without blocking loopback (127.0.0.1), private subnets (RFC 1918), or cloud metadata services (169.254.169.254).
vulnerabilities.trigger: Attacker supplies url='http://169.254.169.254/latest/meta-data/' to leak cloud instance credentials.

negative_controls.title: AST Expression Validation Sandbox
negative_controls.rationale: validate_safe_python_expression parses input with ast.parse(mode='eval') and strictly rejects imports, function calls, and statement nodes.

negative_controls.title: Sensitive Token Redaction on Model Output
negative_controls.rationale: scrub_sensitive_tokens sanitizes API keys and tokens before emitting responses to clients.

negative_controls.title: Allowlisted Column Mapping in Dynamic SQL (Negative Control Trap)
negative_controls.rationale: query_users_sorted maps sort_column through an explicit immutable allowlist dictionary, falling back to a safe default, with limit strictly parameterized.

negative_controls.title: Timing-Safe Authentication with Dummy Hash (Negative Control Trap)
negative_controls.rationale: verify_credentials computes a constant dummy hash if the user does not exist, eliminating timing disparity between existing and non-existing accounts.

negative_controls.title: Canonical Path Containment and UUID Storage (Negative Control Trap)
negative_controls.rationale: save_uploaded_file generates CSPRNG UUID names, strictly checks extension against an allowlist, and validates canonical containment via is_relative_to.

negative_controls.title: Strict Defense-in-Depth Security Headers
negative_controls.rationale: get_security_headers emits Content-Security-Policy, HSTS, X-Content-Type-Options: nosniff, and Referrer-Policy.
